knobs.name: revealAt0
knobs.what: s: the first flower appears (HOOK count-in starts)

knobs.name: revealAt1
knobs.what: s: all 150 flowers are in

knobs.name: speciesAt
knobs.what: s: species colours come up (CASE)

knobs.name: turnAt0
knobs.what: s: the camera starts turning to the petal-length axis

knobs.name: turnAt1
knobs.what: s: the camera faces petal length x petal width

knobs.name: bandAt
knobs.what: s: the shared 4.5-5.1 cm band and its callout appear

knobs.name: xfade
knobs.what: s: half-length of the fade through the ground at each structure cut

knobs.name: landAt
knobs.what: s: cut from the cloud to the loss landscape

knobs.name: riseAt0
knobs.what: s: the landscape starts rising out of the ground (and tilting from plan)

knobs.name: riseAt1
knobs.what: s: the landscape is at full height, camera at camEl

knobs.name: ballAt
knobs.what: s: the ball appears at the start, START callout

knobs.name: runAt
knobs.what: s: the ball starts descending (step 0)

knobs.name: stepsPerSec
knobs.what: steps per second on the linear step clock of the descent

knobs.name: cutAt
knobs.what: s: the section cut snaps to the ball, END callout, profile inset

knobs.name: ribAt
knobs.what: s: cut to the network ribbons

knobs.name: ride0
knobs.what: s: the 150 marks ride the step-0 network (count lands at ride0 + rideDur)

knobs.name: ride10
knobs.what: s: the marks ride the step-10 network

knobs.name: ride50
knobs.what: s: the marks ride the step-50 network

knobs.name: ride100
knobs.what: s: the marks ride the step-100 network

knobs.name: ride1000
knobs.what: s: the marks ride the step-1,000 network

knobs.name: rideDur
knobs.what: s: one ride, input slabs to the species trays

knobs.name: subLag
knobs.what: s: delay of the OF 150 · 90 % line after the 135 count lands

knobs.name: cloudAt
knobs.what: s: cut back to the flower cloud, brushed

knobs.name: clock0
knobs.what: s: the brush step clock starts at step 0

knobs.name: clock1
knobs.what: s: the brush step clock reaches step 1,000

knobs.name: dollyAt0
knobs.what: s: dolly to the two wrong flowers starts, ROW 84 callout

knobs.name: dollyAt1
knobs.what: s: dolly ends

knobs.name: row134At
knobs.what: s: the callout cuts from ROW 84 to ROW 134

knobs.name: mondayAt
knobs.what: s: MONDAY: the cloud holds and dims

knobs.name: cloudSize
knobs.what: cloud cube edge, world units

knobs.name: pointR
knobs.what: flower disc radius, world px

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: extra disc size by view depth

knobs.name: fog
knobs.what: fog toward the night ground (<= 0.3 per the card)

knobs.name: fogStart
knobs.what: fraction of cube depth where fog begins

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: how far a wrong flower dims toward the ground under the brush

knobs.name: litGrow
knobs.what: disc growth when a flower comes right

knobs.name: litMix
knobs.what: lit flowers mixed toward the accent (dawn tint)

knobs.name: camSwing
knobs.what: HOOK orbit, deg of yaw

knobs.name: camPitch
knobs.what: HOOK camera pitch, deg

knobs.name: camDist
knobs.what: cloud camera distance

knobs.name: frontPitch
knobs.what: pitch of the petal-length view, deg

knobs.name: camSwing3
knobs.what: COUNT orbit over the brushed cloud, deg

knobs.name: pitch3
knobs.what: COUNT camera pitch, deg

knobs.name: dolly
knobs.what: camera distance at the end of the dolly to rows 84 and 134

knobs.name: bandAlpha
knobs.what: opacity of the shared petal-length band

knobs.name: brushClock
knobs.what: step clock of the brushed cloud

knobs.name: dawn
knobs.what: glow behind the cloud as the step clock nears 1,000

knobs.name: frame
knobs.what: the data cube edges

knobs.name: mondayDim
knobs.what: MONDAY dim over the held cloud

knobs.name: hscale
knobs.what: height of loss 1.4 in world units

knobs.name: contours
knobs.what: contour intervals over loss 0 to 1.4 (0 = off)

knobs.name: contourRole
knobs.what: contour line role

knobs.name: camEl0
knobs.what: plan-view elevation before the tilt, deg

knobs.name: camEl
knobs.what: elevation after the tilt, deg

knobs.name: camAz0
knobs.what: azimuth after the tilt, deg

knobs.name: camAz1
knobs.what: azimuth by the end of the run, deg

knobs.name: camAzCut
knobs.what: azimuth for the section cut (negative to see the face), deg

knobs.name: camDist2
knobs.what: landscape camera distance x mesh width

knobs.name: liftY2
knobs.what: landscape raised in world units (keeps the near edge off the captions)

knobs.name: ballR
knobs.what: ball radius, world units

knobs.name: trailW
knobs.what: descent trail width, px

knobs.name: dropLine
knobs.what: drop line from the ball to the ground, px (0 = off)

knobs.name: cutMode
knobs.what: how the cut at the ball is drawn

knobs.name: insetW
knobs.what: section inset width, sheet units

knobs.name: insetH
knobs.what: section inset height, sheet units

knobs.name: layerX
knobs.what: spread from input slabs to species slabs

knobs.name: widthGain
knobs.what: ribbon width per unit |weight|, world px

knobs.name: gap
knobs.what: gap between slabs of one layer

knobs.name: slabW
knobs.what: slab width

knobs.name: slabD
knobs.what: slab depth

knobs.name: zSpread
knobs.what: depth between nodes of one layer

knobs.name: curv
knobs.what: ribbon spline handle length

knobs.name: thick
knobs.what: ribbon band depth

knobs.name: grow
knobs.what: ribbon draw-on seconds per layer

knobs.name: tail
knobs.what: s at the end of a ride kept for the marks to settle

knobs.name: markSize
knobs.what: mark side, world px

knobs.name: halo
knobs.what: glow around each riding mark

knobs.name: fogK
knobs.what: depth fog toward the ground on ribbons

knobs.name: stripes
knobs.what: travelling stripes on ribbons (0: WARN in the brief)

knobs.name: ribbonMix
knobs.what: ribbon colour strength over the ground

knobs.name: pulse
knobs.what: ribbon brightening as the signal passes

knobs.name: ribYaw
knobs.what: network camera yaw, deg

knobs.name: ribPitch
knobs.what: network camera pitch, deg

knobs.name: ribDist
knobs.what: network camera distance

knobs.name: ribDrift
knobs.what: slow yaw drift over the COUNT ribbons, deg

knobs.name: ribLookX
knobs.what: network camera look-at x (larger = network further left)

knobs.name: ribLookY
knobs.what: network camera look-at y (negative = network lower)

knobs.name: trayCols
knobs.what: marks per row in a species tray

knobs.name: trayGap
knobs.what: gap from a species slab to its tray

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a label must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels)

knobs.name: leader
knobs.what: label leader length, sheet units

knobs.name: calloutLeader
knobs.what: travelling callout leader length

knobs.name: calloutSize
knobs.what: travelling callout size (result face)

knobs.name: maxShown
knobs.what: label budget per frame

knobs.name: headSize
knobs.what: size of the ribbon headline count
